scientific_limitations: Exact census is restricted to the homogeneous strict 0-or-3-neighbor response on labeled cubic prisms \(C_n\square K_2\) with \(n\ge3\).
The closed-form rate is relative to the uniform distribution on all binary action profiles, not to an evolutionary equilibrium-selection process.
Unindexed equivalent formulations or an earlier specialized graph-enumerator theorem may alter publication priority.
title: Parity-twisted equilibrium census for 0-or-3 public goods on prism networks
